text:
Type: abstract print lumbar cushion
Use: a color and pattern accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: printed cotton fabric
Colors: sky blue, turquoise, black, white, soft pink
Shape: rectangular cushion with a bold abstract print of brushy textures, flowing curved outlines and dense fine black lines, plump and soft, medium size
Feel: lively, artistic, fresh, bold
Goes with: white or grey sofas, solid blue or pink cushions, light wood, modern art; contemporary, eclectic or bohemian living rooms
